text:
anya_sales: Heads-up — Terra Corp wants a short POC next week focused on SSO + SCIM + RBAC. They called out: IdP SAML metadata exchange, SCIM delta sync for ~50k users, and domain ownership validation. Can SE + Sec confirm blockers?
sam_se: Ack. Need to know hosted vs dedicated. Hosted simplifies cert exchange and we can use our OIDC adaptor; Dedicated requires explicit SCIM throughput tuning and EU residency option.
liam_ps: From pricing: 50k profiles + near-real-time deltas will push them into SCIM-plus SKU + possible dedicated capacity. Do we have concrete sync cadence?
anya_sales: They said near-real-time for active staff (every 2–5m) and hourly deltas for the rest. They also want group->role mapping and route isolation based on RBAC.
miriam_sec: Important: Terra is regulated finance. Requirements: DNS TXT domain proofing, SAML fingerprint pinning, customer-managed KMS for audit logs, and SIEM ingestion. Also want data residency in EU.
sam_se: For SAML we can do metadata + cert rotate workflow easily on Hosted for POC. For SCIM at that cadence we should cap throttle to avoid bursts. Proposal for POC: (1) Hosted POC to validate SAML + basic SCIM flows, (2) parallel Dedicated EU connector for sustained delta windows if they require residency/SLA.
liam_ps: Pricing outline draft: Hosted POC — trial credits for SAML testing. SCIM-plus for 50k/1m daily deltas — pricing tier. Dedicated EU node as add-on — monthly commitment. I'll sketch numbers once cadence confirmed.
anya_sales: They asked about failure modes: automatic fallback if SCIM fails — prefer queuing + retries with dead-letter rather than user-facing errors. Supported?
sam_se: Yes. We support durable queuing with exponential backoff and DLQ. For POC we'll enable retries and ship DLQ to their S3. Example config to share: ```
scim:
  mode: "delta"
  throttle_rps: 100
  retry_policy: "exp_backoff"
  dead_letter: "s3://terra-poc-scim-dlq"
```
miriam_sec: Also confirm logs include user_id, scim_request_id, and are sent to their SIEM over HTTPS with TLS1.2+. Retention requested: 1 year. That affects observability add-on.
liam_ps: Noted. Observability retention is a add-on tier. I'll include options (30d / 90d / 1y) in the quote.
anya_sales: List any enterprise blockers we should surface now? Legal + security asks from Terra: SOC2 evidence, subprocessor list, DPA, SCIM rate SLA, domain proofing clause, KMS/HSM integration options, and EU data residency.
sam_se: EU residency requires Dedicated or Private deployment. Hosted is multi-region but not sufficient for strict residency guarantees. SSO uptime SLA available on Dedicated.
miriam_sec: For legal we'll provide SOC2 report and subprocessor list. For KMS we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM in Private and limited bring-your-key in Dedicated — need to confirm exact HSM vendor options. I'll coordinate with infra.
liam_ps: I'll add a pricing appendix for Dedicated EU plus observability and SCIM-plus line items, and include contract addenda for domain proofing and SCIM SLA.
anya_sales: Next actions — @sam_se prepare POC runbook + test plan + minimal config snippets; @miriam_sec collect SOC2, subprocessor list, KMS/HSM options; @liam_ps prepare preliminary quote with SCIM-plus and retention tiers. Terra requested kickoff Tuesday 10:00 CET.
sam_se: I'll deliver runbook and test vectors by Monday EOD.
miriam_sec: I'll pull SOC2 and subprocessors and confirm KMS options by Monday.
liam_ps: Quote draft by Monday EOD as well.
deploy-bot: Created POC workspace terra-poc-1718304321, SAML test endpoint: https://poc.redwood.internal/saml/terra and demo SCIM connector provisioned.
anya_sales: Great — scheduling invite now. :thumbsup:
